subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text :
stimulus: "Why are you putting up the foods in your pockets, sir? Why don't you eat?" asked the nobleman. "I'm doing the right thing. My dress deserves these foods," replied Sheikh Saadi. "I don't understand what you want to mean and I'm sorry," said the nobleman.
guide_solution: The nobleman respectfully asked Sheikh Saadi why he (S) was putting up the foods in his (S) pockets and why he (S) did not eat. In reply, Sheikh Saadi told him (N) that he (S) was doing the right thing and added that his (S) dress deserved those foods. The nobleman said that he did not understand what he (S) wanted to mean and added that he (N) was sorry.

subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text:
stimulus: “Why are you putting up the foods in your pockets, sir? Why don’t you eat?” asked the noble man. “I’m doing the right thing. My dress deserves these foods,” replied Sheikh Saadi. “I don’t understand what you want to mean and I’m sorry,” said the noble man.
guide_solution: The nobleman asked Sheikh Saadi why he (S) was putting up the food in his pockets and why he didn't eat. In reply, Sheikh Saadi told him that he was doing the right thing and added that his dress deserved those rich dishes. Then the nobleman said that he didn't understand what he (S) had meant to say and added that he was sorry.
